messages.subject: Latent density per site
parts:
Hi all,

I am currently using unmarked to calculate snake density in three distinct areas (with slightly different size but roughly 1.5 ha each) throught removal models. I am using the multinompois function and  included the log-area of each site as an offset in the abundance formula to obtain the density. By doing so I obtained much better posterior probabilities for the resulting estimates than when no offset was included (from < 0.5 to > 0.6). However, the estimates were exactly the same as when no offset was included. Therefore, I would to ask you the following questions:

1) Is ranef producing density or abundance estimates?
2) If the estimates when including the offset of the log-area correspond to snake density, how is it possible that they are exactly the same as for the abundance model--i.e., when no offset is included.

Thank you in advance. If needed further details can be provided.

Best

Julien

messages.author: 403be63af7ebf220
messages.subject: Re: Latent density per site
parts:
Hi Julien,

The 'ranef' function is computing abundance, not density, at each site. The abundance estimates should be the same whether you include area as an offset or not. 

Best,
Richard
